0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Hippothoe wishes to conduct another test of the ailouroi's capacity─and yours.

24.original: Speak with researchers at the Twelve Wonders.

48.original: I am so pleased that you're willing to join us in further research.

49.original: Thus far, you have noted this ailouros's response to stimuli.

50.original: However, the ailouroi have one more <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> special capability. Aren't you curious?

51.original: You will be pleased to know that I have dispatched one additional ailouros to fly about the Twelve Wonders, then. If she is working as designed, the phenomenon should be clearly observable.

52.original: I expect that you will be able to collect evidence of it from my fellow researchers...say, Oloros, Deukalion, and Chloris? Do present your conclusions to me when you've finished!

54.original: What fun would it be if I told you in advance? Better that you reach your own conclusions.

55.original: Isn't this the most darling familiar you have ever seen?

56.original: Behold its soft and fluffy fur, its pudgy belly, its charming little bell! Its eyes that gaze imploringly into the very depths of your soul!

57.original: It makes you want to dismantle it and gobble its adorable aether right up, does it not?

58.original: I dare not, of course─whoever it belongs to would be quite cross indeed. Yet even to gaze upon it stokes within me a creative passion the likes of which I've never known!

60.original: Alas, my muse! Perhaps I need create my own familiar of surpassing cuteness after all...

61.original: A tiny winged creature? Do you refer to Hippothoe's familiar, perchance? I did see it not long ago.

62.original: I know not where it's gone off to, I regret to say. I would assist in your search, but I must put brush to parchment before I forget what I meant to write.

63.original: Outside of my observational duties, I have been laboring over a treatise on aquatic flora, you see. Yet rereading my work a moment ago, I was suddenly struck with how trite my conclusion sounds.

64.original: I believe I know precisely how to strengthen it, however. I daresay even Halmarut shall be impressed by my insight!

65.original: I would advise you to keep your head down─I saw some manner of creature darting about in the air just now. If it carries on like that, it's only a matter of time before it collides with someone's skull.

66.original: It startled me so badly that I accidentally created a winged fish─of all things!─which itself escaped to the skies ere I knew it...

67.original: Though, now that I have a moment to reflect on its speedy departure, perhaps the ability to fly is not so wasted upon aquatic creatures as I believed. Surely such a boon would give them heretofore unknown capacity to evade predation...

68.original: The recent fashion for flying concepts may have something to it after all. I really must pay visit to the Bureau of the Architect next I'm in Amaurot─I doubt anyone has registered a <hex:021A020203>winged fish<hex:021A020103> yet.

69.original: Soft fur...wide eyes... Hmm, what else should I add?

70.original: Halmarut may even appoint me to a research position at the Akadaemia Anyder... At last, my time has arrived!

71.original: We were fortunate that it was a <hex:021A020203>happy<hex:021A020103> accident this time, of course. You know how it is─someone yells, “surprise!” and suddenly you've created a stunted serpent with yellow stripes or some nonsense. We can't have that.

73.original: I see you have spoken to everyone. And what are your findings?

74.original: Exactly right! The ailouroi bless those they meet with inspiration.

75.original: After all, we are at our best─and our brightest─when our hearts are at ease. With clarity of thought and faith in ourselves, we can do anything.

76.original: And what could possibly quell inner turmoil so well as a lovable creature like this?

78.original: Ah, it seems duty calls─she senses another irregularity. Off you go then, dear girl!

79.original: With today's results, the ailouros concept will be approved in no time. I am truly fortunate to have such wonderful familiars to work with─yourself included, of course!
